{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders, refunded orders, and keep only loyal customers with completed status
valid_orders = sales[
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') &
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')
]

# Compute and print the mean revenue
mean_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")

# Compute and print the count of valid orders
count_valid = len(valid_orders)
print(f"Number of valid orders: {count_valid}")"}
